r-k-selection-traits.alt: Table comparing r-selected and K-selected species. r-selected: many small offspring, little or no parental care, early first reproduction, short life span, population swings up and down, rebounds fast after a disruption; examples insects, mice, weeds. K-selected: few large offspring, a lot of parental care, late first reproduction, long life span, fairly steady population, recovers slowly after a disruption; examples elephants, whales, oaks.
